hooks.command: f=$(python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input",{}).get("file_path",""))' 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; export PATH="$HOME/Library/pnpm:$PATH"; pnpm exec eslint --fix "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1; pnpm exec prettier --write "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 ;; esac; exit 0

f=$(python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get("tool_input",{}).get("file_path",""))' 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in */app/*|app/*|*/components/*|components/*) python3 -c 'import sys,json;print(json.dumps({"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PostToolUse","additionalContext":"Design check for "+sys.argv[1]+": load the design-system skill, then check the change at 390 px and 1440 px against docs/design/prototype/index.html. Tokens only, no raw hex. Every tap target 44 px or taller."}}))' "$f" ;; esac; exit 0
